thread:
Dana P (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to finalize the HW+Reserved SKU structure for the upcoming marketplace listing. thinking about anchoring to a 12mo commit with renewal uplift. 
Priya R (sales): +1. Customers keep asking for a simple upfront HW credit + monthly commit model. How aggressive are we on discount vs. committed $?
Mateo G (finance): We modeled three bands: 100k, 250k, 500k ARR-equivalent commit. Margins look healthy at 15/18/22% net after credits. can share sheet.
Sara L (legal): Need to ensure renewal terms can't auto-extend beyond marketplace private-offer defaults. we'll need opt-in for auto-renew; add explicit notice 60 days.
Jin K (cloud): Marketplace listing needs metering hooks — sampler event + reserved capacity tag. @Sam T can we add a flag so billing sees bundled HW credit vs. consumption?
Sam T (eng): Yeah, doable. I'll add a boolean on the SKU payload: "hw_bundle_credit": true. minimal backend changes. ETA 3 days.
Karen H (solutions): For SI customers, they want a hardware kick that scales at renewal — e.g., extra free months if they upsell to next band. propose: renewal accelerator = 2 months free on 250k, 4 months on 500k.
Dana P (partnerships): That looks promising. We should anchor headline discount at 20% for 250k band to make it clear, but keep effective discount via credits/announce mechanics.
Priya R (sales): Keep the pricing simple on the private offer tile: "Reserve 12 months, get X HW credits + Y% discount". Sales prefer predictable uplift language.
Mateo G (finance): Quick ask: can we model ARR churn sensitivity if customers take 12mo vs 36mo? 36mo gives better lifetime revenue but we need to cap HW exposure.
Sara L (legal): Cap suggestion — limit hardware credit to the initial 12mo invoice total and pro-rate at renewal. Also add a clause for misuse/returns.
Jin K (cloud): For listing rollout: publish in marketplace EU first then US, region flags set. Also need joint announcement timing — do we coordinate with partner marketing?
Dana P (partnerships): Yes, partner wants a coordinated PR + blog. Proposed timeline: private offer live Day 0, partner co-announce Day 7 after verification window. keeping 1 week buffer for QA.
Sam T (eng): I'll add feature flag for staged rollout and an API endpoint to validate partner entitlements. 
Priya R (sales): Need messaging kit for reps: 1 pager with commit bands, renewal accelerator, and legal caveats. @Dana can you own the one-pager?
Dana P (partnerships): I will. I'll also loop in @Karen for SI-specific sell-in language.
Karen H (solutions): happy to help. can we include a short playbook: "How to position HW credits vs. pure discount" with objection answers?
Dana P (partnerships): Yes. Action items: Sam deploy flag (3d), Mateo share financial sheet (EOD), Sara draft T&Cs (2d), Dana/Karen craft one-pager (3d), Jin schedule marketplace region rollout (TBD). Anyone object?
Mateo G (finance): no objections. i'll attach the sheet in this thread once done.
Sara L (legal): no objections, will ping for clarifications on the cap language.
Priya R (sales): good. Can we also lock a renewal conversation cadence doc? reps need a script for 90/60/30 day nudges.
Dana P (partnerships): will draft a short cadence. closing note: avoid the term "lifetime credit" in public. use "initial term hardware credit" instead. :thumbsup:
